title: Microsoft account recovery lacked consistent attempt-limit enforcement
summary: The cited researcher documents a USD 50,000 award for this finding.
root_cause: Recovery controls did not enforce attempt limits consistently across simultaneous verification operations. Defensive reviews should verify atomic, account-bound limits and consistent treatment of recovery and multifactor checks.
impact: Potential account takeover; the researcher says Microsoft classified severity as Important because practical exploitation required substantial resources.
defensive_takeaways: Bind recovery attempts and verification state to the intended account.
Use atomic security counters and test concurrent state transitions locally.
